impl:GG-0004.title: Market Swing Maximizer
impl:GG-0004.description:
**Market Swing Maximizer** (GG-0004)

You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`-th day.

You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock.

Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If you cannot achieve any profit, return `0`.

Implement `maxSwingProfit` in Code Bench. Pass every sample, then Submit against hidden Arena cases.

This challenge is original to GradeGlow Algorithm Arena — write your own approach.

impl:GGO-001.title: Twin Sum Lookup
impl:GGO-001.description: A cashier scans prices `nums`. Return the indices `[i, j]` (with `i < j`) of the two prices that add up to `target`. Exactly one pair works, and the same index cannot be used twice.

impl:GGO-002.title: Bracket Inspector
impl:GGO-002.description: A code formatter must check that every bracket in `s` (only `()[]{}`) is closed by the same type, in the right order. Return `true` if `s` is balanced.

impl:GGO-003.title: Best Single Trade
impl:GGO-003.description: `prices[i]` is the practice-market price of a share on day `i`. Buy on one day and sell on a later day. Return the largest profit possible, or `0` if every trade loses money.

impl:GGO-004.title: Shelf Finder
impl:GGO-004.description: Library shelf numbers `nums` are sorted ascending and distinct. Return the index of `target`, or `-1` if it is not on the shelf. Aim for O(log n).

impl:GGO-005.title: Stair Paths
impl:GGO-005.description: The library staircase has `n` steps. Each move climbs 1 or 2 steps. In how many different ways can you reach the top?

impl:GGO-006.title: Mirror Message
impl:GGO-006.description: Return `true` if `s` reads the same forwards and backwards after removing every character that is not a letter or digit and ignoring case.

examples.input: s = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

hiddenTests.input: s = "Was it a car or a cat I saw?"

impl:GGO-007.title: Zeros to the Back
impl:GGO-007.description: Rearrange `nums` **in place** so every `0` moves to the end while the other values keep their order. Do not return anything; the judge checks `nums` afterwards.

impl:GGO-008.title: Trending Word
impl:GGO-008.description: Given the words students typed into the campus search bar today, return the most frequent word. If several words tie, return the one that comes first alphabetically.

impl:GGO-101.title: Best Streak Sum
impl:GGO-101.description: `nums[i]` is the change in your study-streak score on day `i`. Return the largest total over any run of consecutive days (at least one day).

impl:GGO-102.title: Unique Signal Run
impl:GGO-102.description: A sensor logs one character per second in `s`. Return the length of the longest stretch with no repeated character.

impl:GGO-103.title: Merge Lab Bookings
impl:GGO-103.description: Each booking `[start, end]` reserves the lab. Merge every overlapping or touching booking and return the merged bookings sorted by start time.

impl:GGO-104.title: Count the Islands
impl:GGO-104.description: A survey map `grid` marks land `"1"` and water `"0"`. Land cells connected up, down, left or right form one island. Return the number of islands.

impl:GGO-105.title: Fewest Coins
impl:GGO-105.description: The campus vending machine gives change using coin values `coins` (unlimited of each). Return the fewest coins that make exactly `amount`, or `-1` if it is impossible. Taking the largest coin first does not always work.

impl:GGO-106.title: Reverse the Chain
impl:GGO-106.description: `head` is the first node of a singly linked list (`val`, `next`). Reverse the list and return the new head.

impl:GGO-107.title: Merge Two Queues
impl:GGO-107.description: Two sorted linked lists `list1` and `list2` hold ticket numbers. Merge them into one sorted linked list and return its head.

impl:GGO-108.title: Tree Height
impl:GGO-108.description: `root` is the root of a binary tree (`val`, `left`, `right`), shown here in level order with `null` for missing children. Return the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to a leaf.

impl:GGO-109.title: Warmer Days Ahead
impl:GGO-109.description: For each day in `temps`, return how many days you must wait for a strictly warmer day. Use `0` when no warmer day comes.

impl:GGO-110.title: Kth Highest Score
impl:GGO-110.description: Return the `k`-th highest exam score in `nums` (counting duplicates; the 1st highest is the maximum).

impl:GGO-111.title: Degree Plan Check
impl:GGO-111.description: There are `n` courses numbered `0` to `n-1`. Each pair `[a, b]` in `prereqs` means course `b` must be taken before course `a`. Return `true` if a student can take every course.

impl:GGO-112.title: Rotate the Floor Plan
impl:GGO-112.description: Return a new `n x n` grid equal to `matrix` rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

impl:GGO-201.title: Rain Catcher
impl:GGO-201.description: `heights` is a skyline of rooftops, each 1 unit wide. After a storm, how many units of rain are trapped between the rooftops?

impl:GGO-202.title: Edit Steps
impl:GGO-202.description: A spell-checker can insert, delete or replace one character per step. Return the fewest steps that turn word `a` into word `b`.
